==Description==
A-20i is the first prime entity out of all primes, and is extremely easy to avoid. It is green and looks nearly similar to A-20.  It's movement speed sounds as if it was A-20 but sped up.

==Behavior==
Upon spawn, A-20i will make a breathing sound like its counterpart, but faster. A-20i will rush to the current room very quickly giving players a few seconds to hide. Once it touches the current rooms door, it will break apart and despawn. Unlike A-20, A-20i instantly kills. 

==Trivia==
*'''A-20i''' is the first super entity.
*'''A-20i''' will not kill the player if they decide to hide using a table (While in the table animation).
*'''A-20i'''<nowiki/>'s name was previously going to get changed to A-25i, this has now been reverted.
*Past A-1000, '''A-20i''' will start to replace A-20 more often
*''Stay Alert'' modifier doesn't affect '''A-20i'''.
* '''A-20i''' has a  1 in 75 to replace A-20 when it attempts to spawn. (Increases as room number increases (in endless) ) (Guaranteed to replace in [[Red Rooms]], room A-2000+ and in any modifier except Stay Alert)
